implementation.mechanism_vs_implementation: nothing of rustc is absorbed: its crate, indexed by rust-analyzer, falsified one Atlas behavior -- a module opened in an import round computed before the scopes it read had settled -- fixed with an Atlas-native rule (causes judged only at a settled round of the fixed point); rustc's name resolution itself (rustc_resolve's indeterminate imports) was not read
implementation.change: adapter semantic::rust::resolve::resolve_imports: a round's glob-import open causes are applied only when no module's scope or shadow set changed in that round (or in a merged oscillation); opening a module starts another round (ADR 0084)
implementation.falsification: regression test a_glob_through_a_named_import_reads_settled_scopes (an enum's variants through the parent's named import, a module renamed by an import in the same module, a glob that never resolves); 2 mutants killed: causes applied every round (the E17 behaviour) fails the new test, causes never applied fails 4 open-scope tests
